metadata.sourceVerification: Every tracked file byte-compared between the clean checkout and build source before execution
metadata.scope: Software sink and offscreen production painter. No audio/MIDI device or native UI interaction.

archiveVerification.scope: Same-host file identity and parsed project fields; not media-content, sound or timing qualification.

faults.scope: Isolated software faults with explicit incomplete-prefix files. No physical device or UI claim.

timed.scope: Real-clock software sink, production arrangement painter without native input/display, synthetic library and virtual lifecycle. No audio/MIDI device or acoustic timing.

threadPolicySnapshots.scope: Requested pthread QoS (overrides are not visible) and sampled Mach time-constraint queries. Not continuous effective scheduling or a kernel wait/fault trace. Five host snapshots outside production callbacks.

cpuDiagnostics.name: clock_gettime(CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID); user+system thread CPU
cpuDiagnostics.scope: Enclosing thread CPU observations include clock-read overhead; units and reported resolution do not guarantee accounting precision. No hour pass.

timed.processActivityPolicy: JUCE scoped user-initiated process activity during playback; macOS only, no-op elsewhere

timingTrace.clock: std::chrono::steady_clock nanoseconds; wall duration, not thread CPU time
timingTrace.selection: First 256 blocks with wake or process call >= half their interval, or a missed virtual deadline; global maxima retained separately
